description: This file defines and exports several functions related to authentication API interactions, including registration, login, MFA verification, token refresh, and logout.

methods.name: registerApplicant
methods.description: Registers a new applicant by sending email and password to the backend.

methods.name: loginStep1
methods.description: Initiates login by validating credentials, may require MFA.

methods.name: verifyMfa
methods.description: Verifies OTP for MFA and receives tokens, updating stored tokens.

methods.name: refreshTokens
methods.description: Refreshes authentication tokens using a refresh token.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the user by revoking the refresh token.
